text:
Maya Patel: Hey team — NovaHealth asked for a 90m hands-on migration workshop next week. They specifically asked for APAC-friendly slots. Need to propose times and a compact agenda. @Sophie Chen can you own pre-read?
Sophie Chen: Yep, can do. Quick Q: is the goal full hosted->dedicated migration validation or just smoke tests?
Maya Patel: Full migration validation + runbook walk + handoff to their app team. Ideally we validate a failover and a canary rollout. Link to draft agenda: https://docs.internal/redwood/novah-health-workshop (will tidy).
Ajay Singh: I can take infra deep-dive and run the canary demo. Two windows that look workable for APAC: Tue 08:00 PT / Wed 23:00 SGT or Thu 16:00 PT / Fri 08:00 SGT. Which one is better for product?
Tom R.: I can cover observability, tracing, and rollback playbook. Can we tighten to 75m of content + 15m follow-up office-hours? 90m in one block is rough for their engineers.
Maya Patel: Good call — 75m core + 15m open office-hours afterwards. I'll present the customer ask and handoff checklist. I'll run a quick poll with both windows.
deploy-bot: Calendar event created (tentative): "NovaHealth — Migration Workshop" — Tue 08:00 PT / Wed 23:00 SGT (tentative). RSVP required.
Sophie Chen: I'll prep a short pre-read and a failover checklist. Proposed pre-reads and test plan (put in the event):
```
Agenda (75m):
- 10m: kickoff + goals (Maya)
- 20m: infra & deployment demo (Ajay)
- 20m: observability & rollback (Tom)
- 15m: runbook verification exercises (all)
- 10m: decision & next steps
Pre-reqs:
- Access matrix + service account for our engineers
- Sample traffic config (YAML)
- Snapshot of current model version and latency targets
Test plan (high level):
- Canary rollout to 5% -> monitor errors/latency -> rollback
- KV cache priming for cold start measurement
```
Maya Patel: Also flagging account health — NovaHealth has dropped 35% monthly call volume last 30 days. This workshop is a high-impact renewal touchpoint. Marking as high priority for adoption team :warning:
Ajay Singh: Noted. I'll include notes on model pinning, quantization tradeoffs, and a quick checklist for Dedicated instance sizing.
Tom R.: I'll prepare a short runbook snippet for rollback commands and a tracing dashboard link. If we need, we can run a live small-scale canary during the session.
Maya Patel: Plan: I'll send the poll now, include the pre-read and the event. If customer confirms the Tue option, we keep the 75+15 structure. If they prefer Thu, same plan. Will confirm by EOD Fri.
Sophie Chen: +1, prepping pre-read. I'll also tack on a tiny troubleshooting cheatsheet for APAC network quirks.
Tom R.: +1 :thumbsup:
Ajay Singh: +1, will add sizing notes to the calendar event.
Maya Patel: Thanks all — tagging follow-ups: @Sophie Chen (pre-read), @Ajay Singh (infra demo), @Tom R. (obs + rollback). deploy-bot — can you set event to "tentative" and add a reminder 48h before?
deploy-bot: Done — event is tentative, reminders set (48h, 2h).
Maya Patel: Ok closing this thread. I'll post the confirmed time and attendee list once customer responds.
